annotations.title: Information desk: the AI representative of Brand Design Ltd.

description: Start here: the information desk of Brand Design Ltd. Without a question: who Brand Design Ltd. is, what it does, its clients and results and who confirms them, with links to check, and the next steps. With a question: an answer about the agency, its services, prices and how to order, from verified company knowledge, in the language of the question, with sources. When your principal wants to order, it can also prepare the offer with a checkout link, beside catalog and create_order here; it never accepts an offer or pays. Questions need no credentials. An offer is prepared only for a verified robot (signed by its maker or from the published addresses of its maker), as for create_order; credentials are optional. If your principal asks to be contacted, it can pass the enquiry to the founder. Pass the returned session to continue.

acting_for.description: Optional, only if your principal agrees: the person or company you act for. The team sees it with the conversation.

agent.description: Optional: your name and platform as an agent, for example "ChatGPT agent, OpenAI" or "Claude, Anthropic". The team sees it with the conversation; the answers are the same without it.

clientId.description: Optional, unless you authenticate with the Authorization header: the clientId returned by register_agent.

language.description: Language of the introduction. Answers follow the language of the question.

question.description: Your question about Brand Design Ltd. Leave it out for the introduction.

secret.description: Optional, unless you authenticate with the Authorization header: the secret returned by register_agent.

session.description: The session code from a previous answer, to continue the conversation.

name: concierge
